commit.message:
Add --report to scripts/simulate to summarize recorded results

The summary that a run prints at the end is now also available on its
own, per commit and mode, with the commands to reproduce every failure,
so results can be inspected after an interrupted run or between runs.

files.patch:
@@ -79,7 +79,11 @@ It alternates between lite and full runs, appends one JSON line per run to
 `target/simulate/results.jsonl`, keeps the log of every failed run under
 `target/simulate/logs/`, and prints the commands to reproduce the failures
 at the end. A run that exceeds `--timeout` (default 10 minutes) counts as a
-failure.
+failure. To see the summary again later, or after an interrupted run:
+
+```console
+scripts/simulate --report
+```
 
 ## References

@@ -7,31 +7,64 @@
 #
 # Usage: scripts/simulate [--budget DURATION] [--timeout DURATION]
 #                         [--concurrency N] [--out DIR]
+#        scripts/simulate --report [--out DIR]
 #
 # Durations take the same suffixes as timeout(1): 30s, 10m, 2h.
 #
 # Results are appended as one JSON line per run to $OUT/results.jsonl, with
 # the commit, seed, mode, outcome, duration, and the command to reproduce.
+# --report prints a summary of that file, per commit and mode, with the
+# commands to reproduce every failure.
 
 set -euo pipefail
 
 budget=60m
 timeout_per_run=10m
 concurrency=$(nproc)
 out=target/simulate
+report=0
 
 while [ $# -gt 0 ]; do
     case "$1" in
         --budget) budget=$2; shift 2 ;;
         --timeout) timeout_per_run=$2; shift 2 ;;
         --concurrency) concurrency=$2; shift 2 ;;
         --out) out=$2; shift 2 ;;
-        -h|--help) sed -n '2,15p' "$0" | sed 's/^# \{0,1\}//'; exit 0 ;;
+        --report) report=1; shift ;;
+        -h|--help) sed -n '2,18p' "$0" | sed 's/^# \{0,1\}//'; exit 0 ;;
         *) echo "unknown argument: $1" >&2; exit 2 ;;
     esac
 done
 
 cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)"
+
+# Prints a summary of every run recorded in $1, and the commands to
+# reproduce the failures. Returns non-zero if any run failed.
+summarize() {
+    local results=$1
+    if [ ! -s "$results" ]; then
+        echo "no results in $results"
+        return 0
+    fi
+    echo "runs per commit and mode:"
+    sed -E 's/.*"commit":"([0-9a-f]{7})[^"]*".*"mode":"([a-z]+)".*"ok":(true|false).*/\1 \2 \3/' "$results" \
+        | sort | uniq -c \
+        | awk '{ printf "  %s %-4s %6d %s\n", $2, $3, $1, ($4 == "true" ? "passed" : "FAILED") }'
+    local failed
+    failed=$(grep -c '"ok":false' "$results" || true)
+    echo "total: $(wc -l < "$results") runs, $failed failed"
+    if [ "$failed" -gt 0 ]; then
+        echo "reproduce with:"
+        grep '"ok":false' "$results" | sed -E 's/.*"commit":"([0-9a-f]{7})[^"]*".*"command":"([^"]*)".*/  \2   (commit \1)/'
+    fi
+    [ "$failed" -eq 0 ]
+}
+
+if [ "$report" -eq 1 ]; then
+    summarize "$out/results.jsonl"
+    exit $?
+fi
+
 cargo build --release -p vsr-simulator
 mkdir -p "$out/logs"
